approved.metric: Recall@5 and NDCG@5 on the medium retrieval condition
approved.sample: 100 independent labeled queries per seed: 90 positive/boundary/conflict and 10 no-answer negatives; 500 memories with 90% noise
approved.repetitions: 3 fixed insertion-order seeds; 300 query executions per baseline
approved.mode: offline synthetic, manually curated query labels
approved.resume_sentence: 在 100 条独立标注查询、500 条记忆且 90% 噪声、3 个固定种子的离线实验中，相比 FTS5，Product 检索将 Recall@5 从 70.19% 提升到 73.52%（+3.33pp），NDCG@5 从 61.90% 提升到 63.70%（+1.80pp）。
limitations: The dataset is synthetic and manually labeled, not real user traffic.
At 100 memories Product regressed versus FTS5: Recall@5 -3.89pp and NDCG@5 -1.73pp.
P50 latency increased from 2.56ms to 194.17ms in the 500-memory condition.
Both baselines produced results on 90% of no-answer negatives.
The local embedding baseline could not run because installed Transformers requires a Torch module absent from this environment.
approved.forbidden_expansion: Do not claim real-user quality, universal retrieval improvement, embedding superiority, low false-positive rate, or latency improvement.

approved.metric: Observed complete hard-forget pass rate across persisted and retrieval surfaces
approved.baseline: Same records before deletion were retrievable and had embedding-cache and retrieval-event entries
approved.current: After Product hard forget, content-level proof and independent absence checks
approved.sample: 10 uniquely marked memories for each of 3 fixed seeds
approved.mode: offline synthetic; real SQLite/FTS/Product deletion paths; deterministic fake embedding used only to populate the cache surface
approved.resume_sentence: 在 3 个固定种子、30 条唯一记忆的离线删除实验中，Hard Forget 30/30 完成内容级删除证明，并通过 SQLite、FTS、Product 检索、embedding 缓存与检索事件清理验证。
limitations: 30/30 is the observed sample result, not a guarantee of a 100% population reliability rate.
The embedding provider is fake and proves cache cleanup only, not semantic embedding quality.
The experiment is local and does not cover remote replicas or backups outside the garden directory.
approved.forbidden_expansion: Do not claim production-wide erasure, remote-provider deletion, cryptographic erasure, or semantic embedding quality.

not_approved: Small-scale Product retrieval result because it regressed against FTS5.
Embedding comparison because the real local provider did not initialize.
Mutation score as a resume metric because only four targeted mutants were evaluated.
Coverage as a standalone resume metric because it has no before/after baseline.
